newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal Mining to buy optical sensor firm.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal Mining to buy optical sensor firm.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would acquire all the shares of optical sensor company Moririca Electronics Ltd in early December.
Sumitomo Metal Mining declined to comment on the value of the purchase.
Yokohama-based Moririca said it makes and sells sensors for cameras and office equipment such as copiers and facsimile machines.
Moririca, which is not listed, posted sales of 1.5 billion yen in the year to August 31, 1996.

By acquiring Moririca, Sumitomo Metal Mining expects to strengthen its optical sensor business and develop new products which combine the technologies of the two companies, Sumitomo Metal Mining said.
